@[ext] structure WGCDData where

def wGCDData (q r N₁ N₂ : ℕ) : WGCDData :=
  let d := N₁.gcd N₂
  let δ := q.gcd r
  { d := d, d₁ := supportedPart (N₁ / d) d
    δ := δ, δ₁ := supportedPart (q / δ) δ, δ₂ := supportedPart (r / δ) δ
    k₁ := coprimePart (q / δ) δ, k₂ := coprimePart (r / δ) δ
    n₁ := coprimePart (N₁ / d) d, n₂ := N₂ / d }

def WGCDData.D (v : WGCDData) : ℕ := v.δ * v.δ₁ * v.δ₂

  d_pos : 0 < v.d

  δ_pos : 0 < v.δ
  δ₁_pos : 0 < v.δ₁
  δ₂_pos : 0 < v.δ₂
  k₁_pos : 0 < v.k₁

  n₁_pos : 0 < v.n₁
  n₂_pos : 0 < v.n₂
  q_eq : q = v.δ * v.δ₁ * v.k₁
  r_eq : r = v.δ * v.δ₂ * v.k₂
  N₁_eq : N₁ = v.d * v.d₁ * v.n₁
  N₂_eq : N₂ = v.d * v.n₂
  d_eq : v.d = N₁.gcd N₂
  δ_eq : v.δ = q.gcd r
  d₁_support : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ v.d₁ → p ∣ v.d
  δ₁_support : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ v.δ₁ → p ∣ v.δ
  δ₂_support : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ v.δ₂ → p ∣ v.δ
  n₁_d : v.n₁.Coprime v.d
  k₁_δ : v.k₁.Coprime v.δ
  k₂_δ : v.k₂.Coprime v.δ
  n_primitive : (v.d₁ * v.n₁).Coprime v.n₂
  k_primitive : (v.δ₁ * v.k₁).Coprime (v.δ₂ * v.k₂)

private theorem gcd_quotients_coprime {u v : ℕ} (hu : 0 < u) :

  have hg := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left v hu
  change (u / u.gcd v).gcd (v / u.gcd v) = 1
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel hg
  rw [← Nat.gcd_mul_left, Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left u v),
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_right u v), mul_one]

    (a : ℝ) * wPhaseInverse (v.n₁ * v.k₁ * v.k₂) v.D' / v.D' : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)

    wPhaseInverse (v.D' * v.n₂ * v.k₁) (v.n₁ * v.k₂) /

\begin{proposition}[Restricted medium convolution]
\label{prop:current-medium}
Fix $\vartheta=7/32$, $0<\sigma<1/100$, $c_0>0$, a divisor order
$B$, and $0\le\kappa\le\sigma/100$. Let $U,V,Q_1,Q_2,Q_3\ge1$. Suppose
\begin{align}
 c_0x&\le |\mathfrak a|\le x^{1+\kappa},&
 Q_1&<Ux^{-\sigma}, \notag\\
 U^2Q_2Q_3^2&<x^{1-8\sigma},&
 |\mathfrak a|^{\vartheta}UQ_1Q_2^5Q_3^2&<x^{2-15\sigma},
       \label{eq:current-medium-ranges}\\
 U^{1+2\vartheta}Q_1Q_2^{5-2\vartheta}Q_3^{2+2\vartheta}
      &<x^{2-15\sigma}.&&\notag
\end{align}
Let $\alpha$ be one-bounded, supported on an individual interval in
$[U,2U]$ and on
$P^-(n)>x^{1/(\log\log x)^3}$.  Assume its auxiliary-coprimality
Siegel--Walfisz estimate: for every $A>0$, every $k,q\ge1$ and
$(b_0,q)=1$,
\begin{equation}
 \left|\sum_{\substack{n\equiv b_0\pmod q\\(n,k)=1}}\alpha_n
 -\frac1{\varphi(q)}\sum_{(n,kq)=1}\alpha_n\right|
 \le C_AU\tau(k)^{C_0}(\log x)^{-A},
 \label{eq:current-aux-sw}
\end{equation}
with fixed $C_0$ and uniform family constants.  Let
$|\beta_m|\le\tau(m)^B$, $m\in[V,2V]$, and let each $\gamma_i$ be a
separate one-bounded sequence on $q_i\asymp Q_i$, supported on
$(q_i,\mathfrak a)=1$.  For
\[
 \Delta_l=\sum_{n,m}\alpha_n\beta_m
 \left({\bf1}_{nm\equiv\mathfrak a\pmod l}

\]

\end{equation}
The constant is uniform in the residue and families satisfying these
conditions.  Fixed endpoint multiples are absorbed by the strict
power margins.
